purpose.domain_detail: Server-side file handler for an ISAM/indexed file named FSGROLE (likely a roles/security table in a Spanish ERP or management system). Acts as a subprogram server dispatching CRUD and navigation operations on the file.
purpose.summary: SSGROLE is a subprogram that acts as a file-server for the indexed file FSGROLE, handling open/close, read, write, rewrite, delete, start (sequential positioning), next/previous record navigation, and bulk get/set operations. It communicates via a pipe-delimited protocol (ESCRIBIBLE flag selects between pipe calls and SYSIN/SYSOUT). It also supports audit tracing via SRUTRAZA.

notable_features: COPY directives for file SELECT and FD (FSGROLE-SEL, FSGROLE-FD)
EVALUATE dispatch on operation codes (TODOS, REA, WRI, REW, DEL, NEX, PRE, etc.)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
